description: Defines data structures and class for RLC Transmission Mode (AM) entity in 5G NR protocol stack, including SDU info, state management, and interface methods for handling SDUs, PDUs, and status reports.

classes.name: rlc_tx_am_entity
classes.description: Represents the Transmission Mode (AM) RLC entity responsible for transmitting SDUs, handling retransmissions, and managing transmission window and state.

classes.name: rlc_tx_am_state
classes.description: Holds the internal state variables for the AM RLC transmission entity, including sequence numbers and poll status.

classes.name: rlc_tx_am_sdu_info
classes.description: Container for SDU data, segmentation progress, retransmission info, and timestamps for transmission.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all timers and halts the entity's operation.

methods.name: set_status_provider
methods.description: Sets the status provider for receiving ACK/NACK status reports.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SDUs for transmission, with indication if it is a retransmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards an SDU identified by its PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Builds and retrieves the next PDU for transmission.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Returns the current buffer state of the entity.

methods.name: on_status_pdu
methods.description: Handles incoming status PDUs (ACK/NACK).

methods.name: on_status_report_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in status reports.

methods.name: get_polling_bit
methods.description: Determines whether to set the polling bit in a PDU header based on current conditions.

methods.name: on_expired_poll_retransmit_timer
methods.description: Handler for expired poll retransmit timer, triggers retransmission logic.

methods.name: inside_tx_window
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is within the current transmission window.

methods.name: is_tx_window_full
methods.description: Checks if the transmission window is full.

methods.name: valid_ack_sn
methods.description: Validates if an ACK SN is within the acceptable range.

methods.name: valid_nack
methods.description: Validates if a NACK is within the acceptable range.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal state variables (for testing).

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current internal state variables (for testing).

methods.name: build_new_pdu
methods.description: Constructs a new RLC PDU from SDUs.

methods.name: build_first_sdu_segment
methods.description: Builds a PDU containing the first segment of an SDU under segmentation.

methods.name: build_continued_sdu_segment
methods.description: Builds a PDU containing a continued segment of an SDU under segmentation.

methods.name: build_retx_pdu
methods.description: Builds a retransmission PDU based on the retransmission queue.

methods.name: handle_status_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming status PDUs, schedules retransmissions, and removes acknowledged SDUs.

methods.name: handle_nack
methods.description: Schedules retransmission for NACKed PDUs.

methods.name: increment_retx_count
methods.description: Increments the retransmission count for a specific SN.

methods.name: decrement_retx_count
methods.description: Decrements the retransmission count for a specific SN.

methods.name: check_sn_reached_max_retx
methods.description: Checks if a SN has reached maximum retransmission attempts.

methods.name: handle_changed_buffer_state
methods.description: Defers notification of buffer state changes to the lower layer.

methods.name: update_mac_buffer_state
methods.description: Immediately updates the MAC layer with current buffer state.

methods.name: log_state
methods.description: Logs the current internal state of the entity.
